torqueHeldLine: {i} A for {t} N·m at magnet {m} °C (duty {iReq} A)
torqueNotHeldLine: {i} A, torque {err} % off {t} N·m at magnet {m} °C — not held
torqueHeldTip: The coupled loop corrected the phase current after each electromagnetic pass so the shaft torque meets the duty's {t} N·m at that pass's own magnet and coil temperatures (load angle unchanged). Ended at {i} A, torque {err} % (band ±{tol} %), magnets {m} °C; the duty is sized at {iReq} A. Every loss, temperature and time to the limit on this card belongs to {i} A.
staleBuildTip: Computed on another build of this configuration ({keys}). The duty is open on the current build; recompute to refresh these numbers.
rippleNotAccurateTip: At {layers} air-gap layer(s)/side the rotor- and stator-side rings disagree by {err} % of the ripple scale: the mesh, not the machine, sets the ripple. Torque, losses and heat are fine. Refine ripple solves this point at 3 layers/side or more, for the ripple only; the mesh settings and the duty stay as they are.
rippleRefinedTip: Ripple refined at {layers} air-gap layers/side; the base run ({baseLayers}/side) read {base} %. Everything else on the card is the base run.
end3dStatusTip_verified: The 3-D factor's 2-D agreement check passed: the end deficit L(1 − k) is constant over the stack lengths solved, so the 3-D and 2-D models agree.
end3dStatusTip_unverified: The 3-D factor is applied but its 2-D agreement could not be checked (fewer than two usable stack lengths, or a passport older than the check). Re-run Stage A with the auto stack lengths to verify it.
end3dStatusTip_failed: The 3-D and 2-D models disagree beyond the end effect: the pure 3-D end factor k_flux_self is applied instead of k_flux. Recompute Stage A.
end3dStatusTip_invalid: The 2-D reference of the Stage A run is zero or not a number: no 3-D / 2-D ratio exists and k_flux_self is applied. Recompute Stage A.
